subject: Coord: ML platform technical session — scheduling & agenda
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lena Korhonen <lena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step: ML platform technical session (60-90m)

Hi Lena — great call earlier, thanks for walking through FinLytics' immediate priorities. Quick recap from our side and a concrete next step:

Recap (high level):
- Primary use case: near-real-time risk scoring for loan approvals (inference qps ~250 peak, bursty).
- Current infra: Kubernetes-hosted model service, CPU-based batching today, planning GPU pilot.
- Key constraints: latency 150ms p50 target, strict PII handling, SOC2 docs requested.

Next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical session with our ML/infra leads to map an initial serving architecture and confirm SLOs. Suggested goals for the session:
- Walk through FinLytics' current data flow and model footprint
- Pinpoint latency and throughput bottlenecks and acceptable tradeoffs
- Discuss deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) and compliance controls
- Outline a proof-of-concept plan and owner list

Proposed slots (your TZ was Europe/UTC+2):
- Thu May 13, 10:00–11:30 CEST
- Fri May 14, 09:00–10:30 CEST
- Mon May 17, 14:00–15:30 CEST

Attendees we plan to bring: Sergio (serving/runtime), Ben (solutions), and me (AE). Please let us know who from your side should join (ML lead, infra lead, security/compliance).

I've attached a short discovery notes dump and a one-page TDX outline to help prep. If any of the proposed slots work, I can send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks — Hannah

---
Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 3 pages), redwood-tdx-outline.pdf (1 page)
